name: site-footer
description: Marketing footer: brand + tagline column, link columns and a legal bar; router-agnostic via linkComponent.
designIntent: Footers are copied between projects with inconsistent link handling. SiteFooter provides the standard multi-column layout, safe external links and a legal row.

props.name: columns
props.description: Link columns: { title, links: { label, href, external? }[] }.

props.name: linkHrefProp
props.description: Prop used to pass the destination to linkComponent: href for anchors/Next Link, to for react-router.

props.name: activeHref
props.description: Current route, used to mark the matching link with aria-current=page.

props.name: match
props.description: Prefix matching highlights parents of the current route; exact only identical hrefs.

antiPatterns.title: Don't duplicate the same links in two columns
antiPatterns.explanation: Keep each destination in exactly one column for predictable scanning.
